meta.title: Yanyan Toolkit
meta.description: One bundle with three independently toggleable plugins: Plugin Update (checks local and registry plugin versions, updates them one by one), Session Management (auto-archive / auto-delete, single and batch delete, reusing the existing dsh-session-archive package), and Subagent Management (session header tab, per-row delete, clean all idle, and idle-time auto-cleanup). Install this one package to get all three.
